apks.help: Download Max_Payne_VR_Nightmare_Edition_*.apk from the developer's Google Drive link and pick the file.

inputs.label: Max Payne Mobile 1.7 (64-bit) APK and OBB
inputs.help: Your own Rockstar Max Payne Mobile 1.7 (64-bit) APK and its main.<number>.com.rockstar.maxpayne.obb file. Pick both.

steps.why: Android creates Android/data/com.MPQ.HaveliSkywalker/files on the first launch.

steps.text: Open MP VR from Library > Unknown Sources. It checks your copy of Max Payne Mobile and unpacks it. Keep the headset on and the app open until it finishes, then restart the app.

notes: APK only on Google Drive and Discord; no GitHub release. The app checks the Rockstar APK by SHA-256 and that the OBB belongs to it; the hash is not in the guide. The guide does not launch first; the launch is there so Android creates the folder. Needs enough free space to unpack the game data; the guide gives no figure. Optional music and language files are not modelled.
